newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's Network Ten in deal with Columbia.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's Network Ten in deal with Columbia.

text.p: Australian television broadcaster Network Ten Ltd said on Wednesday it had signed a seven year television programming deal with Columbia Tristar Television Australia, a unit of Sony Corp.

In a joint statement, the companies said the agreement involved the continuity of supply of international programmes to Ten as well as co-production of Australian programs, including made-for-television movies and television series.
"The agreement which runs to 20003, is an extension and enhancement of the existing programming agreement between Ten and Columbia," the companies said in a joint statement.

Canadian businessman Israel Asper's company CanWest Global Communications Corp has a 76 percent economic interest in Ten Network but under Australian foreign shareholder regulations is only entitled to a 15 percent voting interest.
Media watchdog, the Australian Broadcasting Authority (ABA) is currently investigating CanWest's influence over Ten.
The ABA has said its investigation will focus on whether Asper has breached the Broadcasting Services Act on foreign ownership and control of commercial television licenses.
